description: This file defines an enum ExecShellWrapperParser for parsing and identifying command wrappers for different shell environments (POSIX, CMD, PowerShell). It contains methods to extract command payloads, handle nested wrappers, and recognize specific shell invocation patterns.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser
classes.description: An enum acting as a namespace containing static methods and internal data structures for parsing shell wrapper commands.

classes.name: ParsedShellWrapper
classes.description: A struct representing whether a command is a shell wrapper and its associated command string if applicable.

classes.name: Kind
classes.description: An enum representing the type of shell (posix, cmd, powershell).

classes.name: WrapperSpec
classes.description: A struct defining the shell kind and associated command names for identification.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Main entry point to extract and identify a shell wrapper command from a command array and optional raw command string.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Determines the payload part of the command based on the shell kind.

methods.name: extractPosixInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline POSIX shell commands from command argument array.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline Windows CMD commands following '/c' flag.

methods.name: extractPowerShellInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts PowerShell inline commands from command argument array.
